basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Long-term Research Internship Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Applied Geophysics, Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad, has invited applications for 2 Long-term Research Internship positions on the TEXMiN/IMiN sanctioned project "Exploration for Critical Minerals Using Geophysical Data, Mineral Systems Frameworks, and Artificial Intelligence Techniques". The fellowship is Rs. 10,000/- per month. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, which is sanctioned for 1 year or the end of the project, whichever is earlier. It is meant for pre-final year or final year M.Sc. Tech/Integrated M. Tech. students of II

how_to_apply: Prepare your CV and testimonials as a single PDF.
Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator at both [email protected] and [email protected].
Write the email subject line as: Application for the position of Research Internship under SRDP 1418 G
Complete the Google form with necessary details at https://forms.gle/7193rXC8Riub3t8i6.
important_instructions: The application email must go to both [email protected] and [email protected]. The email subject line must read as given in the notice, with project number SRDP 1418 G. The notice also asks for completion of the Google form. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is pre-final year or final year M.Sc. Tech/Integrated M. Tech. students in Applied Geophysics or any other discipline from IIT(ISM) Dhanbad, with CGPA 7.5 or above. Desirable: candidates with experience in AI/ML applications in geoscience will be given preference. Age and relaxation: as per the norms of the Govt. of India for recruitment of internship. The notice prints no age figure. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 10,000/- per month. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, which is sanctioned for a period of 1 year or the end of the project, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Long-term Research Internship Job Description
content_sections.text: Development of AI/ML & DL-Based Predictive Models for mineral prospectivity mapping Uncertainty quantification Geological overlay analysis Presentation preparation

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Long-term Research Internship
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV and testimonials as a single PDF. Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator at both [email protected] and [email protected] . Write the email subject line as: Application for the position of Research Internship under SRDP 1418 G Complete the Google form with necessary details at https://forms.gle/7193rXC8Riub3t8i6 . Send the application by 29 November 2026 (Sunday).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Shortlisted candidates will be communicated through email tentatively by 30 November 2026 to appear for an online/offline interview. Mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview.
